title: A Molecular Modeling Approach to Identify Potential Antileishmanial Compounds Against the Cell Division Cycle (cdc)-2-Related Kinase 12 (CRK12) Receptor of Leishmania donovani.
authors: Broni, Emmanuel; Kwofie, Samuel K; Asiedu, Seth O; Miller, Whelton A 3rd; Wilson, Michael D
one_liner_zh: 该研究针对利什曼原虫激酶CRK12进行分子对接与MD模拟筛选抑制剂，对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: The huge burden of leishmaniasis caused by the trypanosomatid protozoan parasite Leishmania is well known. This illness was included in the list of neglected tropical diseases targeted for elimination by the World Health Organization. However, the increasing evidence of resistance to existing antimonial drugs has made the eradication of the disease difficult to achieve, thus warranting the search for new drug targets. We report here studies that used computational methods to identify inhibitors of receptors from natural products. The cell division cycle-2-related kinase 12 (CRK12) receptor is a plausible drug target against Leishmania donovani. This study modelled the 3D molecular structure of the L. donovani CRK12 (LdCRK12) and screened for small molecules with potential inhibitory activity from African flora. An integrated library of 7722 African natural product-derived compounds and known inhibitors were screened against the LdCRK12 using AutoDock Vina after performing energy minimization with GROMACS 2018. Four natural products, namely sesamin (NANPDB1649), methyl ellagic acid (NANPDB1406), stylopine (NANPDB2581), and sennecicannabine (NANPDB6446) were found to be potential LdCRK12 inhibitory molecules. The molecular docking studies revealed two compounds NANPDB1406 and NANPDB2581 with binding affinities of -9.5 and -9.2 kcal/mol, respectively, against LdCRK12 which were higher than those of the known inhibitors and drugs, including GSK3186899, amphotericin B, miltefosine, and paromomycin. All the four compounds were predicted to have inhibitory constant (Ki) values ranging from 0.108 to 0.587 muM. NANPDB2581, NANPDB1649 and NANPDB1406 were also predicted as antileishmanial with Pa and Pi values of 0.415 and 0.043, 0.391 and 0.052, and 0.351 and 0.071, respectively. Molecular dynamics simulations coupled with molecular mechanics Poisson-Boltzmann surface area (MM/PBSA) computations reinforced their good binding mechanisms. Most compounds were observed to bind in the ATP binding pocket of the kinase domain. Lys488 was predicted as a key residue critical for ligand binding in the ATP binding pocket of the LdCRK12. The molecules were pharmacologically profiled as druglike with inconsequential toxicity. The identified molecules have scaffolds that could form the backbone for fragment-based drug design of novel leishmanicides but warrant further studies to evaluate their therapeutic potential.
abstract_zh: 由锥虫科原生动物寄生虫利什曼原虫引起的利什曼病负担之重众所周知。该疾病已被世界卫生组织列入旨在消除的被忽视热带病清单。然而，现有锑剂药物耐药性证据的日益增多使得该病的根除难以实现，因此有必要寻找新的药物靶点。我们在此报告了利用计算方法从天然产物中识别受体抑制剂的研究。细胞分裂周期2相关激酶12（CRK12）受体是针对杜氏利什曼原虫的一个可行药物靶点。本研究构建了杜氏利什曼原虫CRK12（LdCRK12）的三维分子结构，并筛选了来自非洲植物区系中具有潜在抑制活性的小分子。使用GROMACS 2018进行能量最小化后，通过AutoDock Vina对包含7722种非洲天然产物衍生化合物和已知抑制剂的整合文库进行了针对LdCRK12的筛选。发现四种天然产物，即芝麻素（NANPDB1649）、甲基鞣花酸（NANPDB1406）、苯并菲啶碱（NANPDB2581）和森尼卡那宾（NANPDB6446），为潜在的LdCRK12抑制分子。分子对接研究显示，化合物NANPDB1406和NANPDB2581对LdCRK12的结合亲和力分别为-9.5和-9.2 kcal/mol，高于已知抑制剂和药物（包括GSK3186899、两性霉素B、米替福新和巴龙霉素）。所有四种化合物被预测具有从0.108到0.587 μM的抑制常数（Ki）值。NANPDB2581、NANPDB1649和NANPDB1406也被预测具有抗利什曼活性，其Pa和Pi值分别为0.415和0.043、0.391和0.052、以及0.351和0.071。分子动力学模拟结合分子力学泊松-玻尔兹曼表面积（MM/PBSA）计算强化了它们的良好结合机制。大多数化合物被观察到结合在激酶结构域的ATP结合口袋中。Lys488被预测为LdCRK12 ATP结合口袋中配体结合的关键残基。这些分子在药理学上被评估为具有类药性且毒性无关紧要。所识别的分子具有可作为基于片段的创新杀利什曼剂药物设计骨架的结构，但需进一步研究以评估其治疗潜力。
